topic: Various types of fuels, their properties and usage.
syllabus_extract: Various types of fuels, their properties and usage. usages of additives
specific_objectives: 24.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to identify various types of greases, fluids and compounds.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Identification of fuel types and additives from samples; Safety: PPE mandatory; Supervision: Instructor monitors handling.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of aviation fuel?
Name one common additive used in aviation fuels.
Why is fuel quality critical for aircraft performance?

topics: Jet A and Jet A-1 specifications
development.content:
Jet A and Jet A-1 specifications
Kerosene-based fuel properties
Freezing point and flash point
Water and sediment tolerance
Density and specific gravity

Fuel additives and their functions
Corrosion inhibitors usage
Static electricity dissipaters
Ice prevention agents
Metal passivators role

Storage and handling procedures
Contamination prevention measures
Dispensing equipment operation
Safety protocols during transfer
Inspection and testing methods

summary_questions: Explain the difference between Jet A and Jet A-1 regarding freezing points.
Describe how corrosion inhibitors protect fuel system components.
List three safety precautions when handling aviation fuels.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the specific properties required for high-altitude fuel usage to be discussed in LP 02.
